verdict.rationale: dltHub documents a decorator-based Python API for scheduling, refreshing, backfilling and observing runs, deployed with `dlthub deploy` (dlt-docs-11, dlt-docs-68). Its orchestration product schedules and chains pipelines, including lineage-aware runs driven by agents (dlt-docs-59, dlt-docs-70), and the AI Harness lets coding agents deploy and run pipelines on managed infrastructure (dlt-docs-14). The open-source library can also be scheduled through GitHub Actions or Airflow/Dagster (dlt-docs-42, dlt-docs-62). Missing for 10: detailed docs on schedule semantics (cron syntax, triggers), clarity that native scheduling depends on the managed dltHub platform rather than the OSS library, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the scheduling features.
